headlines.title: FDA Expands Eli Lilly's Blood Cancer Drug Label in First-Line Setting
headlines.summary: Eli Lilly announced FDA approval for Jaypirca (pirtobrutinib) as a first-line treatment for previously untreated CLL/SLL patients without 17p deletion. The drug reduced disease progression or death risk by 80% versus chemoimmunotherapy in the phase III BRUIN CLL-313 study. Jaypirca sales grew 66% to $357 million in H1 2026, with the drug's non-covalent BTK inhibitor mechanism differentiating it from competitors like Brukinsa, Calquence, and Imbruvica.

headlines.title: Immunogenomics Market Size, Share, Trends, and Growth Forecast, 2026-2033 | NGS and Personalized Medicine Drive Market Toward USD 9.82 Billion at 5.97% CAGR
headlines.summary: The global immunogenomics market is projected to grow from USD 6.32 billion in 2025 to USD 9.82 billion by 2033, expanding at a CAGR of 5.97%. Key applications include oncology, infectious disease research, vaccine development, and autoimmune disorder studies, with adoption across hospitals, diagnostic laboratories, pharmaceutical companies, and academic institutions.

The buyback programme, announced in February 2026 with a budget of DKK 1.1 billion, has now accumulated 1,280,000 shares (1.50% of share capital) since its March 2026 start date. The programme will conclude by January 31, 2027.

XTIA.title: מועד אחרון בעניין XTI Aerospace: רוזן, המייצג משקיעים וזוכה להערכה ברמה הארצית, קורא למשקיעי XTI Aerospace, Inc לשכור ייעוץ משפטי לקראת מועד אחרון חשוב במסגרת תביעה ייצוגית בניירות ערך – XTIA
XTIA.summary: Rosen Law Firm announces an October 27, 2026 deadline for investors to join a securities class action lawsuit against XTI Aerospace, Inc. The lawsuit alleges that company executives engaged in undisclosed activities, failed to maintain adequate disclosure controls, and made materially false statements about the company's business and prospects, resulting in investor losses when the truth was revealed.

XTIA.title: XTI AEROSPACE DEADLINE: ROSEN, NATIONALLY REGARDED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages XTI Aerospace, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - XTIA
XTIA.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against XTI Aerospace, Inc. for allegedly making materially false and misleading statements during April 15 - August 17, 2026. The lawsuit claims senior executives engaged in undisclosed activities that affected disclosure controls and prevented timely earnings report filings. Investors who purchased securities during this period may be eligible for compensation. The deadline to serve as lead plaintiff is October 27, 2026.

EC.title: New Strong Buy Stocks for October 5th

JYSKY.title: Share repurchase programme: Transactions of week 40 2026

BVNRY.title: Bavarian Nordic – Transactions in Connection with Share Buy-Back Program
BVNRY.summary: Bavarian Nordic A/S has announced transactions under its share buy-back program launched on September 1, 2026, with a budget of DKK 250 million through October 30, 2026. APLD.title: New Strong Sell Stocks for October 5th

ABDBY.summary: Alm. Brand A/S upgraded its 2026 full-year guidance following favorable Q3 results driven by low major claims, weather claims, and run-off gains. VEEV.title: Company News for Oct 5, 2026

CSCO.title: Stock Market News for Oct 5, 2026
CSCO.summary: U.S. stock markets closed higher on Friday as investors reacted to weaker-than-expected September employment data. Nonfarm payrolls increased by only 29,000 versus the expected 79,000, pushing the unemployment rate to 4.2%. The Nasdaq Composite rose 1.2%, the S&P 500 gained 0.7%, and the Dow advanced 0.5%. The weak jobs report increased expectations that the Federal Reserve may maintain interest rates in the 3.75%-4.00% range.
